snapshot.source: Ethereum mainnet via Blockscout + Crypto.com ETH_USD

architectures.label: On-chain SSTORE
architectures.note: Readable during EVM execution. Content is public on-chain — strategy leaks to searchers.

architectures.label: Event logs
architectures.note: Write-only from EVM; requires off-chain indexer to read. Public content.

architectures.label: IPFS + on-chain CID
architectures.note: Flat cost: one SSTORE per call stores the CID. Memory blob lives off-chain.

architectures.label: TEE + attestation hash
architectures.note: Encrypted memory in hardware enclave. Only attestation hash touches the chain.
